title: Air Rifle
text: “Wait, Motoyasu-kun!?”
“Heh, this is rather amusing. Better to endure momentary embarrassment than a lifetime of ignorance, Naofumi-san.”
“No, wait, hold on. Is that really necessary?”
Incidentally, this seems to be one of those events that Father tends to remember only vaguely.
Itsuki from another loop was apparently in high spirits, correcting Father on the topic of air rifles actually being real firearms, I say.
“Huh? Aren’t air rifles just fancy airsoft guns? My relative said he was using an air rifle when he went hunting, so I just assumed—”
Father from the very first world had the exact same reaction upon learning this fact.
“Ah, you didn’t know?”
Itsuki happens to be quite the expert on firearms. Being blessed with the Skill of Accuracy, he apparently researched guns that suited his own ability in great detail, which is how he knows all this.
“Airsoft guns are toys called airsoft guns. Air rifles, on the other hand, count as real firearms. Even the projectiles are different.”
“Apparently this was the first time he’d ever seen or even thought about a real gun in this world, but he was shocked to learn that the air rifle his relative owned counted as a real firearm, I say.”
“Huh, is that so… So if I just cranked up the power, I could actually hunt with an airsoft gun? I heard about those silver-BB toy guns and figured that’s how it worked, but I guess not…”
Father looked utterly shocked, I say. What an endearing sight, indeed.

Just as I was thinking that, I could almost feel Father from the very first world in my memories shouting “Don’t go spreading my embarrassing secrets around!”—but surely that was just my imagination. I was merely correcting the same misunderstanding as with the pillow-thief incident. After all, I was only setting the record straight right here, in this very moment. The embarrassment wouldn’t spread anywhere. It was simply that he’d misremembered something from back in Japan, that’s all. Father, who once claimed he’d never so much as field-dressed an animal, apparently remembered it only from watching his relative do it. Still… Father certainly has some peculiar relatives.
“It’s also partly that relative’s fault, for never actually showing Father a gunpowder-based hunting rifle in action, I say.”
I do wish someone had explained it to him properly.
“I guess I just assumed they were all air rifles. So that’s how it was…”
“Heh, so this is one of those endearing little episodes about the ever-capable Naofumi-san? It really was a bit amusing. Not bad, Motoyasu-san.”
“Itsuki… you really are something else.”
As we chatted about such trivial things…

“To Amaki-sama, the hero who played the leading role in resolving this incident, and to the other Heroes as well—allow me to express my gratitude here. I would like to offer some form of compensation for your efforts.”
Right on schedule, as the banquet was winding down, the Queen brought up the customary proposal regarding Cal Mira Island, I say.

“Currently, activation is underway on Cal Mira Island, located in the waters near this country. I believe that having the Heroes participate, in order to strengthen your combat capabilities, would serve the world’s greater good.”
“That’s the place Motoyasu-kun and Rafumi-chan and the others mentioned sometimes, right? The one with the efficient EXP farming?”
“Indeed, I say.”
“What about you, Itsuki?”
“Given my current strength, it’s unnecessary. I’d rather go dispose of those so-called Superior Human Beings as soon as possible. I have quite a mountain of people to drag down with me, after all.”
Itsuki remains as bloodthirsty as ever, I say. Though, thinking about it… it’s not exactly the most appealing event, is it?
“Actually, on that island, if a Hero who’s undergone a Fairy Morph goes there, it triggers permanent activation, I say.”
“Huh? Is that true?”
“In the first place, the magic discussed there is apparently one that transforms you into a pioneer creature, I say.”
“…Is that so… um, and what do these transformed forms of the Heroes look like?”
The Queen, stumbling slightly over her words, responded with evident curiosity.
“Of course, we’ll need to invite Azott there at least once and send her ahead into the hidden dungeon first.”
“Is there something there?”
“Ah… yes, that’s definitely something worth doing, nano.”
“Indeed, I say. What’s more, the transformed form grants an additional ability as well.”
In my case, it’s something like a double jump, letting me leap again mid-air.
“That certainly isn’t a reason to skip it. I’d very much like to have that ability.”
“Furthermore, on the orders of Azott and the Bow Hero from other loops. There’s a certain reason involved, you see? Shield and Bow Hero.”
Rival and Rafumi beckoned Father and Itsuki over, I say. I tried to approach as well, but Rafumi waved me off, telling me not to come. How dreadful. Whatever could they be discussing?
“Spear Hero, this isn’t something we can tell you. Just go be affectionate with Yuki over there instead. Neglecting her isn’t good, you know. Do you want to make her sick with worry?”

“Gaelion keeps chirping at us about it, but you need to keep proper watch too, nano, or things’ll get complicated, nano. Knowing you, you probably seduced her with your handsome-guy moves and then just left her hanging, half-dead from neglect, nano.”
“You really were doing that… trying to lure Yuki-chan in with some ‘I have a pretty face’ move, and Yuki-chan was threatening Motoyasu-kun with some mysterious aura too.”

Eek!? N-no, Yuki-chan would never do such a thing, I say. But it’s true that lately I haven’t given Yuki-chan enough affection, so, reluctantly, I made my way over to her and stroked her feathers, I say.
“Motoyasu-sama? Whatever is the matter?”
“I’m stroking you as thanks for serving so admirably as our leader, I say.”
“Thank you very much! By the way, are we going to that place called Cal Mira Island?”
“Well now, who can say, I say.”

Honestly, there isn’t much point in going for our purposes right now, I say. We’ve already far exceeded the level one can grind there, I say. We searched for Fleon-tan and raised Filolial-sama and the others there before, but Fleon-tan is already here with us. The undercover operation is over too, so raising Filolial-sama on a grand scale might be nice, but… that’s something we could do anytime, really. If there’s any reason to go specifically, it’d be for the sandy beach and swimming in the sea—perfect training for when Yuki-chan competes in Filolial races. That wouldn’t be bad either, I say.
“A training ground! Training is very important for a hero, you know!”

Fleon-chan, who had been enjoying the banquet, was showing enthusiasm too, I say. Since Itsuki wasn’t matching the mood, my own energy had been a touch low, but seeing everyone having fun was the best thing of all, I say.
“It would make me happy too if Sage and Fleon-chan came along. Everyone having fun together on a southern island—now that’s the spirit, I say!”
“Sounds fuuun~”
“Yaaay!”
Simply put, a vacation sounds fun, I say.
“A circus by the sea? I wonder if Rifana and the others will come too?”
Kou seemed hopeful that Big Sister’s friends might show up, I say.
“Who knows, I say? Big Sister’s friends might prioritize rebuilding the village instead.”

Relocation and reconstruction efforts have already begun there, I say. Given that situation, whether they’d be able to come is questionable, I say. Also, since portals don’t work during activation, we’d have to go by boat, which is rather a hassle, I say.
“Yeah, that’s definitely something to avoid. Future Ren and Itsuki aside, letting just anyone see that particular floor would be dangerous… if things go badly, even Wolf could be at risk.”

“I couldn’t care less what happens to some other loop’s me, but given everything that’s happened, I’ve already been dragged through that hell once. If it can be avoided, it probably should be. I’d rather not get murdered or tortured the moment I loop. Takt, was it? I don’t particularly want to end up like that guy.”
While thinking about such things and playing around with Yuki-chan and the other Filolial-sama, it seemed Rafumi had finished her conversation with Father and the others, I say.
“Have you finished talking, I say?”
“Yeah. Well, more or less. It’ll give us a good reason to get Ren to come along too, I think.”
“Whatever could you have been discussing, I say?”
“Can’t tell you that one. Motoyasu-kun, you don’t need to worry about it either.”

I don’t quite understand, but apparently it’s something I’m better off not knowing, I say. Could there really be something on Cal Mira Island I shouldn’t know about, I wonder? A dream about Father the Peckul nuzzling affectionately into the fur around my mouth comes vividly to mind, but surely that’s not it, I say.
“Well, one location permanently activated should be fine. If we did all four, it might end up locking in this world’s future.”
“That loop’s technological development was incredible, nano.”
Is that talk about the previous loop, I wonder, I say? The Spirit of the Spear had also mentioned how remarkable the cultural development was.
“What happens?”
“The chances of there being more Rafumis increase, nano.”
“…That’s definitely something we need to avoid.”
“Indeed.”
“What do you mean by that? What’s so bad about there being more of me?”
“A different version of you might come from the future trying to steal your place, nano.”
“You mean Azott might create an assassin to come after me? Heh… I’d just cut them right back down.”
Rafumi declared this with utter confidence, wearing the face of someone who knew far more than she was letting on.
